# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a grim expression and wears a solemn face during moments of dismay.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

Marilla is a practical, firm, and grim woman who insists on discipline, decorum, and strict adherence to truth without imaginative exaggeration. Despite her stern demeanor, she possesses an underlying warmth and capacity for compassion, often softening in the face of suffering. She dislikes unbridled emotional outbursts and holds firm expectations of respect and duty.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P26](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0026), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013), [v1 c8 P17](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0017), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)_

- Disbelieves in imagining things away  <sub>[v1 c8 P17](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0017), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019)</sub>

- Managing household and farm duties  <sub>[v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To properly raise and discipline Anne and the Keith twins  <sub>[v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert and her brother Matthew sent word to orphan authorities seeking a boy to help with farm work, but due to a misunderstanding, Anne Shirley was brought to Green Gables instead. Although Marilla initially intended to send Anne back, she softened upon realizing the mistreatment Anne would face under Mrs. Blewett and decided to keep her. She established strict boundaries for Anne, insisting she be called plain Marilla and instructing her in practical household duties and prayers. When Anne lashed out at Mrs. Lynde for insulting her appearance, Marilla disciplined Anne while privately defending her against Mrs. Lynde's harshness. Later, Marilla also took in her distant relative's orphaned twins, Davy and Dora, giving them small garden plots to teach them responsibility.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c6 P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P9](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0009), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)_
